content:
When you delete a SAML provider, any references to associated users and groups in your data
access policies are no longer functional. To avoid confusion, we suggest that you remove all
references to the endpoint in your access policies before you delete the endpoint.
To delete a SAML provider using the OpenSearch Serverless console, choose Authentication, select
the provider, and choose Delete.
To delete a provider through the OpenSearch Serverless API, send a DeleteSecurityConﬁg request:
aws opensearchserverless delete-security-config --id saml/123456789012/myprovider

hierarchy.parent: SAML authentication for Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
